worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.summary: Punch a nearby target and recover health based on the damage dealt.
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.description: The punch deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
Punch reach %1$s blocks (also the real range), knuckle radius %2$s blocks.
%1$s of the damage dealt is restored to the user.
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.combo.on: Jab string: one straight punch becomes three, each lighter and siphoning less, but the total is higher, crits come more often and recovery is longer.
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.combo.off: Single punch: one clean straight that siphons more and recovers fast, good for sustain.
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the punch power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the punch power rises to %2$s and the drain share to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.use.0: Snap the shortest punch in when toe to toe
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.use.1: Trade the damage for healing as you brawl
worldcombat.skill.drainpunch.use.2: Land three hits at once with the jab string
On: one straight punch becomes three, with a higher total and more crits, but each hit is lighter, siphons less and recovery is longer. Off: one clean straight that siphons more and recovers fast.
